releases.displayName: Update regarding our last Harvest Life announcement

items.text: Hi there!

As you may remember, we delightedly announced last time that we're planning on releasing new updates for Harvest Life. We wanted to treat both Harvest Life and our community to some extra TLC. Following up on that, many of you sent us a lot of feedback and quite a few requests, which went a long way in motivating us even more!
But, unfortunately, we have to tell you today that we won't be able to provide you with new updates at this stage. We're sorry to disappoint you. This was anything but an easy decision for us.
We had to consider several factors.

But the main reason is that we couldn't find a suitable team of developers to continue working on Harvest Life. We were very close to closing a deal with a motivated team, but we had to cancel it at the very last moment.
As you may imagine, the current Covid-19 situation doesn't exactly make it any easier to finalize such a project.

We really wanted to make another update for Harvest Life. But in the current situation it's just not possible. Many thanks to all you busy farmers out there. Your feedback and joyous anticipation were a great incentive to us.

If you're still looking for new worlds to discover and farm, we recommend our most recent release Stranded Sails: Explorers of the Cursed Islands. Discover a great mix of farming and adventure in a mysterious world that's becoming even more varied with each content update we publish.

As a little "thank you" for moving to the Cursed Islands we can make you a very special offer: As owners of Harvest Life you can buy Stranded Sails: Explorers of the Cursed Islands for the discounted "Farmer Bundle" price!
Just follow the link to jump straight into your next big adventure:
Thank you for your patience and enthusiasm. We hope you'll still enjoy Harvest Life and/or take a trip to the Cursed Islands. In any case, we'll be here for you and listen!
Cheers,
your rokaplay team!
P.S.: Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments or follow our Discord channel: discord.gg/rokaplay

releases.displayName: Stranded Sails - Tropical farming adventure ahoy!

items.text: Dear farmers,

A remote tropical archipelago with... open world farming for survival... numerous explorations and adventurous discoveries... story driven quests... supernatural dangers.... ancient mysteries... pirate setting... in a low-poly art style! That's the best way to summarize Stranded Sails.
With the developer, Lemonbomb, we will soon set sail and embark on an adventurous journey. Are you onboard? Well, then put the game on your wishlist right now!
Become part of the crew and experience a cheerful and relaxed single-player farming adventure in a tropical island paradise!
Dear farmers,

Our Japanese hobby farmers now have the opportunity to play the game in their native tongue. We hope this will increase the enjoyment of the game in the "Land of the Rising Sun" as well as inspire those who don't speak English so well. For everyone else we have made various improvements, such as:
Changelog 2.7.3
Enhanced & improved the tutorial
Japanese language: Bugs
Stock all now stocks the additional slot, too
Game no longer shuts down when over-filling a chest with multiple items at the same time
Shop and smithery now properly shows the correct costs for all items
Animation fixes
Sprinkler no longer turns when deactivated
Weekday-display sometimes didn't show up properly
Hi everyone,

We are looking for intrepid farmers who would like to become the first explorers of the cursed islands. Imagine you're ship-wrecked on a mysterious, uninhabited archipelago. As a crafty farmer, you immediately know what to do to prevent starvation. But you must also prove yourself as a dauntless adventurer to finally escape the islands!
Would you love to test a unique mix of adventure and farming simulation? Well, apply as a Beta Crew by subscribing to our Mailing List

We'd love to send out a version for testing to each and every one of you and stay in touch. However, for organizational reasons, that's not possible, and we can only accept a limited number of testers.
How do we pick our testers?

To make sure that everybody has a fair chance and we get a good selection of testers with different gaming profiles we'll be sending out a questionnaire about your gaming habits and preferences along with our newsletter shortly. It will provide us with all the basic info we need - of course, anything you enter will be treated as confidential and only be used for beta testing. We won't make your data available to any 3rd parties.
For all of you, who won't be able to join us as beta testers, we're already preparing quite a treat that will also provide more insights into the game!

In addition: We'd love to invite all of you to our group chat on Discord where you can get in touch with our team, the developers and other players. Stay up to date and get first-hand info! Join us now!
We can't wait to play with you guys!
Best,
Kerstin
Dear farmers,
From now on there are closing times for the shops in the village and we added more environmental animals amongst other fixes.
The shop & smithery will now ocassionally offer delivery-quests (announced in the newspaper), this way you can gain gold and empty your stock faster
We reworked and improved fishing, it should feel more smooth now and the upgrades&skill-level have more impact
Fences now support three- and four-way junctions
Steam big picture support
Steam-Controller support
Controller support in Editor improved
We added more environmental animals (rabbits, ducks and fish): Balancing
The town's smith and shop are closed on sundays now
Logs value reduced to 20 (from 25): Bugs
Sometimes the player got stuck when declining an escort-mission
Available escorts and quests weren't available after a game-restart anymore
Game didn't always show the "Game Saved" notification
Newspaper related to dog will only appear after rescuing the dog now
Newspaper-achievement works now properly again
Clock will no longer show 60 minutes (which it sometimes did before)
Dear farmers,

Many thanks for your new reviews! Please keep writing to us! The reviews are an important source for improvements and motivate us to continue working on the game. This update includes some major bugs that we have fixed. And beware: vegetables decay now if they don't get enough water!
Changelog 2.6.0
Controller-Support for woodcutting and farm-editor and improved in other areas
Additional environment animals
Animals will now fall asleep during the night
Vegetables will now rot if you don't water or harvest them for several days
Players can build now benches to nap (not very comfy) on
Escorts and other missions from the shop, restaurant and smithery will be announced in the newspaper (via a note) now: Graphic
Additional graphical feedback for users about what is happening: Balancing
Children won't visit the farm after dusk anymore
Additional newspaper-entries (easier to get the achievement now)
Smithery and shop are now closed during the night: Major Bugs
4:3 UI bug fixed (in hotfix a few days ago)
Fishing-tutorial sometimes got stuck (in hotfix a few days ago)
Players occassionally got stuck while loading into an escort-mission
"Stock all" now correctly stocks all 4 inventory slots
Animation bugs
Dog-Quest couldn't be completed in some occassions due to the dog not being responsive: --
Dear farmers,
We are happy to announce a new update including new localizations (Italian & Spanish) as well as a big polish. Our improvements in detail:
Changelog 2.5.0
Improved performance
4 new character-models
New buildable object: Sprinkler, which use up energy to water your crops
New buildable object: Well
New languages: Spanish, italian, traditional chinese
Added "stock all" button for chests and shop
Lots of new sounds
Environment animals
Hints (from grandpa) can now be deactivated in the options: Graphic
Graphical rework (performance)
UI improvements to increase user-experience
Troughs will now show their fill height (water and fodder)
New animations & improvements
Fence-Gates improved to stand out better
Week-day window altered so it wouldn't stand out as much
Rain-Graphic reworked: Balancing
Shop-sales increased
Linux savegame problem solved
Placing the same type decoration on another will not cost any gold anymore, so that the player can decorate the farm the way he wants less costly
Generator runs slower to make it easier
Splitting wood into logs will now gain 2 instead of 1 log
Droplings & Eggs will spawn less often
Apples cost reduced from 20 to 10
Player will only wake up automatically during 7am and 8pm
Berry-bushes cost less but can not be picked as often
Lumberjack levels up a bit slower
Animals will follow the player longer after getting fed by hand: Bugs
(Controller) Volume is updated right away instead of when the options are opened the next time
(Controller) Volume can now be dropped to 0% properly
Localization fixes
Players sometimes accidently fed animals several times in a row
Players sometimes accidently filled troughs several times in a row
Intro-carriage runs smoother
Tutorial-inconsistencies improved and indicator added to show when a player action is required
Sometimes the spouse wore her old job's mailbag
Mouse-Movement adjusted to feedback

The player's cat will now spawn back at the farm if it was deleted accidently in one of the early versions of the game: In the meantime, if you are interested in getting access to preview versions of our games or our newsletter with lots of insider information, please feel free to put your name on our 100% spam free mailing list on https://www.rokapublish.de/mailing-list .
Dear farmers,

We know you haven't heard from us for a while. The reason is that we put all our attention into the game that we're working on continuously. And the harvest for you is near! Soon there will be a new update, which will surely please you. And even better: We are planning a multiplayer mode! We just ask you for a little patience! So, stay tuned... ;-)

In the meantime, if you are interested in getting access to preview versions of our games or our newsletter with lots of insider information, please feel free to put your name on our 100% spam free mailing list on https://www.rokapublish.de/mailing-list .
